We have applied three templates sequentially, got precursors at each step.

First step (template 324324) gave two products: product1: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1" and product2: "Nc1ccccc1N". That seems to split the amide? Actually original target had ...C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So after first step we have a carboxylic acid (C(=O)O) and an aniline diamine.

Second step (template 1914396) applied to first product gave "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" and "O=C(O)CC(=O)O". So we transformed the side chain from /C=C/C(=O)O to C=O (aldehyde?) Actually got a aldehyde? The second product is a dicarboxylic acid (oxalic acid? O=C(O)CC(=O)O is succinic acid). Might be a protecting group removal.

Third step (template 733) applied to "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" yields something? We haven't applied yet. Need to apply template 733 to that molecule to get precursors.

Let's apply template 733.
